source_note: Capacity figures sourced from official authority records and widely-reported public figures. Infrastructure details (gates, security lanes, concessions) are estimated from public reporting and comparable-venue analysis unless otherwise noted. Confidence levels — high: official authority/permit records; medium: press releases, widely-reported public figures, venue official pages; low: estimated from comparable venues or derived from site footprint.
data_quality_notes: app.py VEGAS_VENUES lists 'Mandalay Bay Events Center' and 'Michelob Ultra Arena' as separate entries. They are the same physical venue (renamed March 2022). The Michelob Ultra Arena entry in app.py has an inflated capacity (20,000 vs actual ~12,000) and coordinates that are ~1.4 km north of the actual location. This is flagged per venue below.
app.py 'Resorts World Amphitheatre' (outdoor_factor: 0.90) likely conflates the indoor Resorts World Theatre (5,000 seats) with the adjacent outdoor areas. Flagged below.
